DATE September 24, 1969

N.Y.O. 625

MEMORANDUM
The American Tobacco Company

To Mr. J. A. McGinn Corporate Media Department

FROM H. M. Boggiano
Corporate Media Department

SUBJECT

For your reference, I attach a copy of a memorandum over the signature of Mr. N. B. Lufty, Manager, Reidsville Branch, and a letter dated September 10 from Judge A. Pierce of the Reidsville Chamber of Commerce, requesting that we reserve space on a new Reidsville area map.

It is the wish of the Department of Manufacture to participate and would appreciate it if you will arrange to send Mr. Lufty suitable copy for a 6" x 6" advertisement.
Mr. Krauskopf suggested a sort of "Welcome to Visit" factory copy depicting the cigarettes that are manufactured at the branch, that is, LUCKY STRIKE Regular, PALL MALL Regular and PALL MALL Filter.
The cost for the advertisement will be absorbed at the branch and naturally the cost of the copy will be charged to the Department of Manufacture.

Attachments

[SIGNATURE] \( (1,b,\cdots,b) \) oqqiano
